verdict: Local visibility is up; no paid campaigns are active to drive leads.
narrative: This period, all activity came from organic sources — no paid ads ran on any channel. Your Google Business Profile was the standout, generating 65 actions (39 requests for directions, 25 website clicks, and 1 call), with engagement up 18% compared to the prior week. Website sessions came in at 167 for the 28-day window, though that week-over-week figure dipped 13%; the day-by-day pattern shows traffic is currently flat rather than trending in either direction. Conversion tracking on the site is being reviewed, as zero conversions were recorded despite the sessions — that number under-reports until the fix is confirmed. With a paid campaign in place, the local interest already showing in your Business Profile would have a direct path to booked leads.

highlights.phrase: Google Business Profile actions this period — directions, site clicks, and calls
week-over-week rise in Business Profile engagement
website sessions this period, all from organic traffic

watch_item.issue: Zero conversions recorded across 167 website sessions — tracking may not be capturing form submissions accurately.
watch_item.fix: Conversion tracking is being reviewed and repaired so next period's data reflects actual site activity.
